components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width pill CTA, ink fill, used for sign-in, payment, and confirmation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #202020; color: #ffffff; height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(32,32,32,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Outline Icon Button
components.description: Circular secondary action button (back, filter, sign-out) with a hairline border.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-outline" aria-label="Back"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.25" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #ececea; background: #ffffff; color: #202020; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f5f5f3; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(32,32,32,0.5); }

components.name: Category Pill
components.description: Horizontally scrolling filter pill; active state inverts to ink fill.
components.css: .ds-pill-row { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-pill { flex-shrink: 0; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; background: #f5f5f3; color: #6b6b68; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #ececea; } .ds-pill-active { background: #202020; color: #ffffff; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(32,32,32,0.5); }

components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-tile:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-tile-image { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; color: rgba(32,32,32,0.8); } .ds-tile-mint { background: #eafcd7; } .ds-tile-badge { position: absolute; top: 0.625rem; right: 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(32,32,32,0.7); } .ds-tile-info { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.125rem 0; } .ds-tile-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #202020; } .ds-tile-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6b6b68; } .ds-tile-price { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #202020; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Nav
components.description: Floating pill nav with two circular icon destinations (Home, Account); active destination inverts to a paper-filled circle.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #202020; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); width: fit-content; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #ffffff; color: #202020; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Borderless muted-fill field used in the login form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #6b6b68; font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; } .ds-input { height: 3rem; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: #f5f5f3; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #202020; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6b68; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(32,32,32,0.5); }

narrative.overview: Smart Fridge compresses a physical vending purchase into a single-handed phone flow: near-black ink typeset in Rubik's confident geometric weight sits on a cream-and-white ground, with pastel-coded tiles standing in for a product catalog that doesn't exist yet. There is no browsing chrome, no cart, no multi-step checkout — every screen is a full-bleed phone card carrying exactly one job (browse, decide, pay, unlock). The palette is loud in small, specific places (a pill button, a stock badge, a tone field) and otherwise gets out of the way of black text on white. The system was brief-pinned from a Figma type/color spec sheet and three snack-vending app screens; the shipped build honors that pinning almost exactly — same ink/cream/pastel palette, same pill-everything form language, same stepper and bottom-tab patterns — with the one durable adaptation being PhoneShell, which turns the reference's implicit "this is a phone app" into an explicit, enforced layout rule for a real responsive web build.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ink (#202020) on white/cream grounds; color is reserved for tone fields, pills, and the primary CTA, never for body text.
Rubik at heavy weights (700-800) for every heading; body and label text stay at regular/semibold Rubik.
Pill radius (full) on every interactive control: buttons, category filters, nav, badges, quantity stepper.
Large corner radius (1.25rem+) on every card, sheet, and product tile — nothing in the system has a sharp corner.
One phone-shaped canvas per screen (PhoneShell), never a fluid desktop grid.

rules.name: The Ink-Only-Text Rule
rules.body: Body and heading text are always --foreground (near-black) or --muted-foreground; pastel tokens never carry text, only fills behind icons or full-screen state grounds.

rules.name: The One Pastel Per Surface Rule
rules.body: Any given tile or screen uses exactly one tone color as a flat fill — tones are never combined, gradiented, or layered on the same surface.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Every text element on screen resolves to either extrabold (numbers, headings, totals) or a lighter 400-600 weight (everything else) — there is no mid-weight (500-600 headline) register in use.

rules.name: The Structural-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only on elements that are physically floating above another layer (the shell, the nav, the overlapping chip) — cards, tiles, and buttons at rest are flat.

dos: Do keep every route inside PhoneShell — full-bleed under sm, centered max-w-md card with 2.5rem corners and ambient shadow at sm+. This is the system's responsive strategy, not a temporary constraint.
Do use rounded-full for every tappable control (buttons, pills, badges, nav, stepper) and reserve large-but-not-full radii (rounded-3xl/rounded-[2rem]) for image-bearing containers.
Do assign one pastel tone (mint/lavender/blush/sand/cream) per product/state as a flat fill — never gradient or combine tones on one surface.
Do keep shadows structural: only on the shell, the floating nav, and elements that visually overlap another layer.
Do set headings and numerals in Rubik 800; leave everything else at 400-600.
donts: Don't introduce a fluid, multi-column desktop layout — this is a phone-only product by design (PRODUCT.md), and PhoneShell's fixed-card behavior at wide viewports is the intended terminal state, not a gap to "fix" with a responsive grid.
Don't put text on a pastel tone field — tones are backgrounds for icon placeholders and full-screen state grounds only, never a text-bearing surface.
Don't add a third bottom-nav destination or duplicate an existing destination (Home/Account) — the nav was deliberately reduced to two non-overlapping destinations.

Don't add uppercase, letter-spaced "kicker" or eyebrow labels above headings — the type system has no tracked small-caps register anywhere in the shipped build; labels are inline chips/pills, not standalone eyebrow text.

Don't add hard-offset, outlined "neobrutalist" shadows (flat black offset borders) — this world's only shadow vocabulary is soft, diffuse, and structural (see Elevation & Depth); it is not a neobrutalist system.
